To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

a combination of 1) 3 mineral glycine complexes, and 2) 2 CENs significantly enhanced aerobic exercise performance in aerobically fit young adult women, and that these effects are not due to placebo or the generic minerals.
a combination of certain essential and conditionally-essential nutrients improved aerobic exercise performance.
a combination of 36 mg Fe, 15 g Zn, 2 mg Cu as glycinate complexes plus 2 g L-carnitine and 0.4 g phosphatidylcholine improved aerobic exercise performance by fit young adult women.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the effects of a combination of 2 conditionally essential nutrients and 3 mineral complexes on aerobic exercise performance.
how certain essential and conditionally-essential nutrients (CEN) affect aerobic exercise performance.
the role of certain essential and conditionally-essential nutrients in aerobic exercise performance, and with the role of the chelate form of certain minerals in improving such performance.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
a combination of certain essential and conditionally-essential nutrients can enhance aerobic exercise performance.
this study demonstrated that a combination of certain chelated mineral complexes plus two conditionally-essential nutrients improved aerobic exercise performance.

a combination of three minerals in the form of chelated glycinate complexes, plus two conditionally-essential nutrients, significantly improved aerobic exercise performance, as measured by a 3 mile run, a stationary bike test, and a step test, in aerobically fit young women.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the mineral glycinate complexes + CENs increased exercise capacity in aerobically fit women.
a combination of certain essential and CENs can improve aerobic performance.
the mineral complexes and/or CENs may be important for exercise performance.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the mineral complexes are critical for the improvement, and that a lower dose of the CENs (carnitine) may still be effective.
the combination of certain mineral chelates plus two CEN (Carnitine and Phosphatidylserines), can be used to enhance aerobic performance in fit young women.
certain mineral complexes plus CENs may improve aerobic exercise performance.
